contracts: (A non-skipped test discovery reports the account-preservation case and persisted evidence confirms all original account identities and values remain after migration and reuse.) AND (Targeted selector discovers and records non-skipped production-boundary checks for all twelve resource types.) AND (The Restore selector runs against the real operation boundary, is non-skipped, and emits evidence observation.) AND (The exact action-retention selector executes with a nonzero assertion count.) AND (The exact workspace-retention selector executes with a nonzero assertion count.) AND (The migration selector is discovered and verifies no Restore operation is created or started by migration.) AND (The request is denied and no operation record is created or dispatched.) AND (The selector is discovered, non-skipped, and reports the secret-exclusion assertion.) AND (The targeted selector is discovered and confirms denial with unchanged persisted Account status.) AND (The targeted selector is discovered and confirms denial with unchanged persisted credential state.) AND (The targeted selector is discovered and verifies server authorization plus persisted enabled state.)
selector_intents: Execute the A08 Restore-event selector and fail when Restore is not exercised or its retained evidence record is absent.
Execute the A08 secret-exclusion selector and fail if any secret is retained or the exclusion assertion is absent.
Execute the action-retention selector and fail when any exercised operation record lacks action.
Execute the workspace-retention selector and fail when any exercised operation record lacks workspace.
MigrationEvidenceTests verifies populated old-schema account rows and values after startup migration, restart, and database reuse.
PhaseA.Platform.Tests.PhaseB.SnapshotTests.MigrationDoesNotStartRestore verifies startup/database migration does not enqueue or start Restore without an explicit request.
PhaseB.Repair.IdentityBoundaryTests.AdminLifecycle_IsAuthorizedAndAudited_Enable_DeniesInsufficientAdministrator verifies server-side denial and unchanged disabled state.
PhaseB.Repair.IdentityBoundaryTests.AdminLifecycle_IsAuthorizedAndAudited_Enable_WithValidAdministrator verifies valid administrator enablement at the server boundary.
PhaseB.Repair.IdentityBoundaryTests.AdminLifecycle_IsAuthorizedAndAudited_Revoke_DeniesInsufficientAdministrator verifies server-side denial and unchanged credential state.

PhaseB.Repair.IdentityBoundaryTests.PrivateResources_RejectCrossAccountEnumeration invokes production ownership checks for each named resource type and fails when any invocation is missing or routed to a non-production substitute.
